summary: Repeats an image in a tiled pattern and can crop the image bounds before tiling.

key_params.name: cropleftunit
key_params.note: Units for the left crop edge

key_params.name: croprightunit
key_params.note: Units for the right crop edge

key_params.name: cropbottomunit
key_params.note: Units for the bottom crop edge

key_params.name: croptopunit
key_params.note: Units for the top crop edge

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Hold, zero, repeat, or mirror tile edges

key_params.name: reflectx
key_params.note: Reflect tiles in X; requires Tile/Repeat Y set to 2

key_params.name: reflecty
key_params.note: Reflect tiles in Y; requires Tile/Repeat X set to 2

common_gotchas: Crop units decide whether edges are interpreted as pixels or normalized fractions.
Reflect X requires Tile/Repeat Y set to 2, and Reflect Y requires Tile/Repeat X set to 2.
Extend controls sampling at tile edges and is separate from repeat count.
The UI label Transpose maps to the official parameter id flop and does not change resolution.
Overlap blends neighboring tiles and can soften repeated seams.
key_concepts: Tile TOP repeats a cropped source region across the output image.
Crop parameters define the left, right, bottom, and top bounds of the source region before it is tiled.
Extend and reflection controls decide what happens at tile boundaries and whether alternating tiles mirror.
Overlap controls blend adjacent repeats to reduce visible tile seams.
